house.description: Funding provided for support services for young adults released from juvenile detention or prison, and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Public Safety Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; appropriating money for support services for young adults released from juvenile detention or prison.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; 180 DEGREES. +]

[+$250,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for the Office of Justice Programs to provide a grant to 180 Degrees' Great River Landing and Clifton Place programs to engage in community outreach, partnership development, mobile case management, family reunification, aftercare, job attainment, follow up, and housing placement when young adults, up to age 24, are released from juvenile detention or prison. The pilot program must specifically seek to address the lack of resources for the large number of young adults reentering the community post-incarceration or detention. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; appropriating money for support services for young adults released from juvenile detention or prison.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; 180 DEGREES.

$250,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for the Office of Justice Programs to provide a grant to 180 Degrees' Great River Landing and Clifton Place programs to engage in community outreach, partnership development, mobile case management, family reunification, aftercare, job attainment, follow up, and housing placement when young adults, up to age 24, are released from juvenile detention or prison. The pilot program must specifically seek to address the lack of resources for the large number of young adults reentering the community post-incarceration or detention. This is a onetime appropriation.

The pilot program must specifically seek to address the lack of resources for the large number of young adults reentering the community post-incarceration or detention. This is a onetime appropriation.
